# Open Freematics Emulator

> Open-source desktop and web app that controls the Freematics OBD-II Emulator MK2 over USB on
> macOS, Windows and Linux. It sets PIDs, trouble codes, VIN and readiness monitors, updates the
> MK2's firmware, and reads everything back through an ELM327 OBD-II adapter. Independent and
> unofficial: not affiliated with Freematics.

A Rust server owns the USB serial link and speaks the MK2's AT command set. A React client drives
it over typed WebSocket RPC (Effect RPC), and a Tauri shell runs both as a desktop app. A
simulated MK2 (V1.3 firmware behavior) lets everything run without hardware. The firmware wire
key and images are imported from Freematics' own GUI package into the local data directory; they
are never in the repo or a release.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/README.md): features, quick start, desktop builds, firmware import, measured firmware behavior
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/AGENTS.md): architecture, protocol facts and code conventions for contributors and coding agents
- [Rust services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/docs/internals/rust-services.md): rules for server code
- [Web UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/docs/internals/web-ui.md): rules for the React client
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/docs/internals/testing.md): how to write tests
- [Test the app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/.agents/skills/test-emulator-app/SKILL.md): run the app and verify a change on the simulator or a real MK2

## Protocol and contracts

- [RPC contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts): every WebSocket RPC the client can call
- [Emulator state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/packages/contracts/src/emulator.ts): state, inputs and errors as Effect Schemas
- [AT commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/packages/shared/src/atCommands.ts): command builders for the MK2's AT command set
- [PID catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/packages/shared/src/pids.ts): supported PIDs with SAE J1979 encoders
- [Simulated device](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/crates/fme-server/src/device/simulated_device.rs): in-memory model of the MK2 firmware and an ELM327 adapter

## Optional

- [Emulator session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/crates/fme-server/src/emulator/emulator_session.rs): the service that owns device state
- [Firmware updater](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/crates/fme-server/src/firmware/firmware_updater.rs): flashing through the MK2 bootloader
- [OBD reader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/crates/fme-server/src/obd/obd_reader.rs): reads the emulator back through an ELM327 adapter
- [License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETSoftwareStudio/open-freematics-emulator/main/LICENSE): MIT
